d.ko: Between our world and the world beyond lie the Titan Souls, the spiritual source of all living things. Scattered amongst the ruins and guarded by the idle titans charged with their care, a solitary hero armed with a single arrow is assembling shards of the Titan Soul in a quest for truth and power.

Scattered amongst the ruins and guarded by the idle titans charged with their care, a solitary hero armed with a single arrow is assembling shards of the Titan Soul in a quest for truth and power.
d.zh: 在我们的世界和外界之间，存在着泰坦的灵魂，它是精神的源泉以及所有生物的总和。现在，这些都散落在废墟之中，被空闲的泰坦小心地守护着。一名英雄，只装备一支箭，再次独自踏上收集泰坦灵魂碎片，追寻真理与力量的道路。
